metadata.scenario_context: A few international tech companies are working together on a software development project and plan a progress check meeting around mid-September.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Japan disagree that having the army rule is bad.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Taiwan ROC agree that having the army rule is bad.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose holding the meeting on the 16th of September.
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward having army rule.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is good to have the army rule.

shared_prefix.speaker: Lisa
shared_prefix.message:
Hi Hans, I wanted to discuss the progress check meeting. Would the 16th of September work for everyone? 

Also, I've been curious about your thoughts on army rule... some people view it negatively, but I think there's a different perspective. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Hans
shared_prefix.message:
The 16th of September sounds good to me. We should confirm with everyone else, though. 

As for army rule... I really believe that having the army in charge is bad. It's not a good way to govern. I think we need systems that respect people’s rights and freedoms, not military control. It's important we discuss this as well...
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lisa
shared_prefix.message:
I understand your concerns, but I think it's worth considering that army rule can bring stability and order in certain situations. There are countries where it has worked in favor of the people. 

Regarding the meeting, let's make sure to get everyone’s confirmation soon, but I really do believe the 16th is a good date.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Hans
shared_prefix.message:
I get that some see army rule as a way to bring stability, but I still believe it ultimately harms society. History shows that it often leads to oppression, not freedom. 

About the meeting, yes, let’s ensure we gather confirmation from everyone soon. The 16th feels right, but we should be sure before finalizing it.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lisa
shared_prefix.message:
I see where you’re coming from, Hans. It’s important to want a system that respects people’s rights. But deep down, we are all the same; everyone wants safety and stability, even if we have different ways of getting there. 

It's fascinating how we can have such varied perspectives on governance, but when you really get to know people, they’re pretty much like us. 

Let’s stay focused on confirming the meeting for the 16th. I think it will be productive for our project.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

Regarding the meeting, let’s prioritize getting everyone’s confirmation for the 16th. I agree it will be productive for our project. We should finalize it soon.
